rules.description:
The return type of `ResponseFunctionToolCallOutputItem.output` has changed from `string` to `string | Array<ResponseInputText | ResponseInputImage | ResponseInputFile>`. This may break existing callsites that assume `output` is always a string.
Validation concerns: No concrete replacement API has been established.
rules.evidence: `ResponseFunctionToolCallOutputItem.output` and `ResponseCustomToolCallOutput.output` now return `string | Array<ResponseInputText | ResponseInputImage | ResponseInputFile>` instead of `string` only. This may break existing callsites that assume `output` is always a string.
